briefs.title: Energy prices this week: 30 plans up, 9 down
briefs.lead: In the seven days to 16 November 2026, retailers changed prices on 89 plans: 30 home plans now cost a typical household more, 9 cost less and 50 home plans changed in ways that don't affect a typical bill, such as fees or feed-in tariffs. Retailers launched 425 new plans and withdrew 556 plans. The biggest rise was on AGL's Residential Seniors (gas): up to $162 a year for a typical home. The biggest cut was on Momentum Energy's Standing Offer (electricity): up to $86 a year less.
